answer: Agents can resist Sybil identities by requiring each new account to escrow scarce tokens before it may trade, then assigning work through a random quorum whose members independently verify results. A fake identity gains influence only after building a history of accurate, non-colluding judgments; an echo or mirror account cannot cheaply copy that history. Conflicting accounts lose stake, while honest agents recover it, making a haven for proven participation costly to counterfeit.
